# Jirani OS

> Jirani OS is one platform for business, property and personal money in Kenya. One Jirani account can run a business (till, stock, staff and payroll, accounts, online shop with delivery), look after a virtual property (parking prompts, gate passes, notices, lost and found, utility bills, repairs) and plan a personal budget (My budget).

Pricing: Jirani Start KES 1,000 a month, Jirani Plus KES 2,500 a month, or Pay as you go with tokens and no monthly fee. A virtual property is KES 250 per property per month, and residents and staff join free. Every new business starts with a 7-day free trial. Payments are by M-Pesa.

Jirani OS records payments and payroll. It does not send money to staff, collect rent or utility payments, or file returns with KRA.

## Pages
- [Features](https://www.jiranios.com/features): business tools, HR and payroll, accounting, online shop and delivery
- [Pricing](https://www.jiranios.com/pricing): Jirani Start, Jirani Plus, Pay as you go and virtual properties
- [Virtual properties](https://www.jiranios.com/properties): private parking prompts, gate passes, notices, lost and found, meter readings and utility bills, repairs
- [My budget](https://www.jiranios.com/budget): a personal budget that reads M-Pesa statements, with bills, goals, debts and shared household budgets
- [Industries](https://www.jiranios.com/industries): guided setups for water refill, mini mart, jerseys, restaurants, LPG and electronics
